40014511.author: पदार्थः
40014511.content: तदा: then, समितिञ्जयः one who is victorious in wars, सः he, कृत्स्नाम् vast, तांपरिषदम् that assembly, दृष्टवा: on seeing, तदा: then, वाहिनीपतिम् chief of the army, प्रहस्तम् to Prahastha, प्रचोदयामास: ordered.

40014511.author: Translation
40014511.content: Then Ravana who is victorious in wars, looking at the vast assembly (of Rakshasas) ordered Prahastha, the chief of the army.

40014512.author: पदार्थः
40014512.content: सेनापते: O chief of the army चतुर्विधाः warriors of four divisions of army, कृतविद्याः those who are well versed in the knowledge of all kinds of wars, ते: you, योधाः war, नगररक्षायाम् to safeguarding the city, यथा: likewise, स्युः you entrust, तथा: so also, व्यादेष्टुम् you order to be more alert, अर्हसि: you ought.

40014512.author: Translation
40014512.content: "O Chief of the army You order those who are well versed in the knowledge of all kinds of war and entrust those warriors of four divisions of the army to safeguard the city. Likewise, you ought to order them to be more alert."

40014513.author: पदार्थः
40014513.content: प्रणीतात्मा: celebrated, सःप्रहस्तः that Prahastha, राजशासनम् by king's order, चिकीर्षन् desiring to do, मन्दिरे: city, बहिः outside, अन्तश्च: inside, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, विनिक्षिपत् assigned.

40014513.author: Translation
40014513.content: Celebrated Prahastha desiring to carry out the king's order assigned the army inside and outside the city.

40014514.author: पदार्थः
40014514.content: ततः thereafter, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, नगरगुप्तये: for guarding the city, विनिक्षिप्य: having assigned, राज्ञः of the king, प्रमुखे: in front, निषसाद: sat down, जगादच: and appealed.

40014514.author: Translation
40014514.content: There after Prahastha, having assigned the army for guarding the city, sat down in front of the king, and appealed.

40014515.author: पदार्थः
40014515.content: बलवतः one who is powerful, तव: your, बलम् strength, बहिः outside, अन्तश्च: and inside, विहितम् kept, अविमनाः with undistracted mind, ते: to you, यत् that which, अभिप्रेतम् you intend to do, अस्तु: you will, क्षिप्रम् at once, कुरुष्व: you may tell.

40014515.author: Translation
40014515.content: "You are a powerful one. Your army has been posted outside as well as inside. You may tell me at once without any distraction what you intend to do."

40014516.author: पदार्थः
40014516.content: राजा: king, सः that, रावणः Ravana, राज्यहितैषिणः keen on doing good to the kingdom, प्रहस्तस्य: Prahastha's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, सुखेप्सुः desiring happiness, सुहृदाम् dear ones, मध्ये: in the midst, व्याजहार: said this.

40014516.author: Translation
40014516.content: Ravana who was keen on doing good to the kingdom desiring happiness and having heard Prahastha's word, said this in the midst of his dear ones.

40014517.author: पदार्थः
40014517.content: यूयम् you all, धर्मकामार्थकृच्छ्रेषु: among dharma (righteous code of conduct), artha (material wealth) and kama (desire), प्रियाप्रिये: that which is desirable and undesirable, सुखम् happiness, दुःखम् sorrow, लाभालाभे: gain and loss, हिताहिते: good and bad, वेदितुम् to know, अर्हथ: you are capable.

40014517.author: Translation
40014517.content: "When there is doubt about dharma, artha and kama, you are capable of deciphering between desirable and undesirable, happiness and sorrow, gain and loss."

40014518.author: पदार्थः
40014518.content: सर्वथा: always, युष्माभिः all of you, समारब्धानि: started, मन्त्रकर्मनियुक्तानि: that which has been well thought out and decided, मे: by me, सर्वकृत्यानि: actions carried out, जातु: that I know, नविफलानि: never futile.

40014518.author: Translation
40014518.content: "The actions carried out by me are always after it is well thought out and decided by all of you. I know that those actions have not failed."

40014519.author: पदार्थः
40014519.content: ससोमग्रहनक्षत्रैः ruling over the moon, sun and stars, मरुद्भि: even gods, वासवःइव: just as Indra भवद्भिः with you also, वृतः accompanied, अहम् I, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, श्रियम् at once, अवाप्नुयाम् attain fortune.

40014519.author: Translation
40014519.content: "Just as Indra who rules over the moon, sun, stars, and gods attains fortune, accompanied by you I will attain fortune exceedingly at once."

40014520.author: पदार्थः
40014520.content: अहम् I, वः earlier, सर्वान् all, खलु: indeed, समर्थयितुम् right, उद्यतः told you, कुम्भकर्णस्यतु: to Kumbhakarna, स्वप्नात् was sleeping, मम् I, इमम् this, अर्थं: matter, नअचोदयम् not informed.

40014520.author: Translation
40014520.content: "Indeed, rightly I told all of you earlier. Since Kumbhakarna was sleeping I had not informed him about this matter."

40014521.author: पदार्थः
40014521.content: सर्वशस्त्रभृताम् among the wielders of weapons, मुख्यः foremost, अयम् this, महाबलः very strong, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, षट् मासान् six months, सुप्तःहि: was sleeping, सः he, इदानीम् here, समुत्थितः has arrived now.

40014521.author: Translation
40014521.content: "Kumbhakarna, the foremost among the wielders of weapons, is very strong. He was sleeping these six months and has arrived now."

40014522.author: पदार्थः
40014522.content: रामस्य: Rama's, मया: by me, महिषी: consort, इयम् this, जनकात्मजा: Sita, रक्षोभिः Rakshasas, चरितोद्देशात् wandering place, दण्डकारण्यात् from Dandakaranya, आनीता: brought.

40014522.author: Translation
40014522.content: "This Sita, the consort of Rama was brought from D and akaranya, a place where rakshasas wander."

40014523.author: पदार्थः
40014523.content: अलसगामिनी: one whose pace of walk is modest, सा: she, मे: my, शय्याम् bed, आरोढुम् to lay her feet (to love), नइच्छति: not like, त्रिषु: in the three, लोकेषु: in the world, अन्या: others, सीतासदृशी: one who has the looks like Sita, मे: to me, नमता: not think.

40014523.author: Translation
40014523.content: "Sita who walks modestly did not like to enter into my bed (love me ) however much I prayed. I do not think there is anyone who looks like her in the three worlds."

40014524.author: पदार्थः
40014524.content: तनुमध्या: one of slender waist, पृथुश्रोणी: plump hips, शरदिन्दुनिभानना: of autumnal full moon like face, हेमबिम्बनिभा: like golden image, सौम्या: gentle lady, मयनिर्मिता: constructed by Maya (Rakshasa), मायेव: like a magical one.

40014524.author: Translation
40014524.content: "She is a woman of slender waist, plump hips, whose face is like an autumnal full moon. She is gentle and like a golden image. She is like a magical one constructed by Maya."

40014525.author: पदार्थः
40014525.content: सुलोहिततलौ: red coloured soles of feet, श्लक्ष् णौ: smooth, सुप्रतिष्ठितौ: evenly shaped, ताम्रनखौ: pinkish nails, तस्याः of her, चरणौ: feet, दृष्ट्वा: on beholding, मे: my, शरीरजः born in me, दीप्यते: kindled.

40014525.author: Translation
40014525.content: "Beholding her smooth red soles and evenly shaped pinkish nails of feet, love is kindled in me."

40014526.author: पदार्थः
40014526.content: हुताग्निरर्चिः like the sacrificial fire, सङ्काशाम् like the radiance, सौरीम् of Sun, प्रभामिव: like the glow, एनाम् her, उन्नसम् prominent nose, विपुलम् large, वल्गु: attractive, चारुलोचनम् beautiful eyes, तस्याः of her, तत् those, पश्यन् seeing, अवशः surely, कामस्य: by love, वशम् overtaken, एयिवान् slave to her.

40014526.author: Translation
40014526.content: "On beholding the sacrificial firelike face of Sita glowing like the radiance of the Sun, seeing her prominent nose, her large attractive countenance with beautiful eyes surely, I am overtaken by love and have become a slave to her."

40014527.author: पदार्थः
40014527.content: क्रोधहर्षसमानेन: is equal in anger and happiness, दुर्वर्णकरणेनच: makes one pale, शोकसन्तापनित्येन: either in grief or agony, कामेन: by passion, कलुषीकृतः disturbed.

40014527.author: Translation
40014527.content: "I have been disturbed by passion, which is equal in anger or happiness and makes one pale in grief or agony."

40014528.author: पदार्थः
40014528.content: भर्तारम् husband, रामम् Rama, प्रतीक्षमाणा: expecting to come, आयतलोचना: broadeyed Sita, सा: that, भामिनी: beautiful woman, माम् me, संवत्सरंकालम् one year time, आयाचत: had requested, मया: by me, चारुनेत्रायाः lady with beautiful eyes, शुभम् auspicious, तत् that, वचः word, प्रतिज्ञातम् promised in turn, सततम् ever, अध्वनि: feel exhausted, यातः one that has marched, हयःइव: like the horse, अहम् I, कामात् on account of passion, श्रान्त: tired.

40014528.author: Translation
40014528.content: "Broadeyed Sita requested me one year time expecting her husband Rama to come (this is a false statement made by Ravana here) and I promised in turn to Sita of beautiful eyes. Just like an exhausted horse that marched I am tired on account of my passion."

40014529.author: पदार्थः
40014529.content: भर्तारम् husband, रामम् Rama, प्रतीक्षमाणा: expecting to come, आयतलोचना: broadeyed Sita, सा: that, भामिनी: beautiful woman, माम् me, संवत्सरंकालम् one year time, आयाचत: had requested, मया: by me, चारुनेत्रायाः lady with beautiful eyes, शुभम् auspicious, तत् that, वचः word, प्रतिज्ञातम् promised in turn, सततम् ever, अध्वनि: feel exhausted, यातः one that has marched, हयःइव: like the horse, अहम् I, कामात् on account of passion, श्रान्त: tired.

40014529.author: Translation
40014529.content: "Broadeyed Sita requested me one year time expecting her husband Rama to come (this is a false statement made by Ravana here) and I promised in turn to Sita of beautiful eyes. Just like an exhausted horse that marched I am tired on account of my passion."

40014530.author: पदार्थः
40014530.content: अक्षोभ्यम् unassailable, बहुसत्त्वसमाकीर्णम् inhabited by many crocodiles, सागरम् the ocean, वनौकसः Vanaras, तौ: both the, दशरथात्मजौवा: even the sons of Dasaratha, कथम् how, तरिष्यन्ति: will they cross.

40014530.author: Translation
40014530.content: "How will the Vanaras and even both the sons of Dasaratha be able to cross the unassailable ocean inhabited by huge crocodiles?"

40014531.author: पदार्थः
40014531.content: अथवा: Even so, एकेन: singly, कपिना: monkey, नः let us think, महत् great, कदनम् most difficult, कृतम् after having done, कार्यगतयः did and went, दुर् ज्ञेयाः is difficult to ascertain, यस्य: his, यथामति: whatever you feel, ब्रूत: you may tell.

40014531.author: Translation
40014531.content: "Even so, a huge destruction was done to us, by a single monkey. The consequences of their acts are unpredictable. Tell me what is there in your mind, according to your own understanding."

40014532.author: पदार्थः
40014532.content: मानुषात् of human beings, नः to me, भयम् fear, नास्ति: not there, तथापि: in the same way, विमृश्यताम् let it be deliberated, तदा: then, देवासुरेयुद्धे: in the battle of Devas and asuras, युष्माभिः you also, सहितः along with, अजयम् victory, मे: to me, ते: by you, भवन्तश्च: as it is all of you, तथा: be like that, नृपात्मजौ: sons of King (Rama and Lakshmana), सीतायाः Sita's, पदवीम् a way out, प्राप्या: gain, सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् Sugriva and other leaders, हरीन् Vanaras, पुरस्कृत्य: placed in front, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, परे: shore, पारे: collected, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, the ocean, सम्प्राप्तौ: arrived.

40014532.author: Translation
40014532.content: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."

40014533.author: पदार्थः
40014533.content: मानुषात् of human beings, नः to me, भयम् fear, नास्ति: not there, तथापि: in the same way, विमृश्यताम् let it be deliberated, तदा: then, देवासुरेयुद्धे: in the battle of Devas and asuras, युष्माभिः you also, सहितः along with, अजयम् victory, मे: to me, ते: by you, भवन्तश्च: as it is all of you, तथा: be like that, नृपात्मजौ: sons of King (Rama and Lakshmana), सीतायाः Sita's, पदवीम् a way out, प्राप्या: gain, सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् Sugriva and other leaders, हरीन् Vanaras, पुरस्कृत्य: placed in front, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, परे: shore, पारे: collected, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, the ocean, सम्प्राप्तौ: arrived.

40014533.author: Translation
40014533.content: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."

40014534.author: पदार्थः
40014534.content: मानुषात् of human beings, नः to me, भयम् fear, नास्ति: not there, तथापि: in the same way, विमृश्यताम् let it be deliberated, तदा: then, देवासुरेयुद्धे: in the battle of Devas and asuras, युष्माभिः you also, सहितः along with, अजयम् victory, मे: to me, ते: by you, भवन्तश्च: as it is all of you, तथा: be like that, नृपात्मजौ: sons of King (Rama and Lakshmana), सीतायाः Sita's, पदवीम् a way out, प्राप्या: gain, सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् Sugriva and other leaders, हरीन् Vanaras, पुरस्कृत्य: placed in front, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, परे: shore, पारे: collected, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, the ocean, सम्प्राप्तौ: arrived.

40014534.author: Translation
40014534.content: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."

40014535.author: पदार्थः
40014535.content: यथा: that way, सीता: Sita, आदेया: without giving, दशरथात्मजौ: Dasaratha's sons,वध्यौच: to kill, भवद्भिः you may also, मन्त्रः suggestion, मन्त्र्यताम् thinking over, सुनीतम् good scheme, अभिधीयतांच: and suggest me.

40014535.author: Translation
40014535.content: "You may also think over and suggest to me a plan to kill Rama and Lakshmana without giving Sita."

40014536.author: पदार्थः
40014536.content: वानरैः Vanaras, सागरम् ocean, तीर्त्वा: to cross, अन्यस्य: no one, कस्यचित् as such, शक्तिम् capacity, नप्रपश्यामि: I do not find in any one, मम: to me, जयः will be victorious, निश्चयेन: surely.

40014536.author: Translation
40014536.content: "No one can cross the ocean with Vanaras (help). As such I do not find anyone has the capacity. I am certain of victory."

40014537.author: पदार्थः
40014537.content: कामपरीतस्य: seized with passion, तस्य: his, परिदेवितम् lamentation, निशम्य: hearing, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, प्रचुक्रोध: enraged, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् च: uttered.

40014537.author: Translation
40014537.content: On hearing the lamentation of Ravana seized with passion, enraged Kumbhakarna uttered these words.

40014538.author: पदार्थः
40014538.content: सलक्ष्मणस्य: accompanied by Lakshmana, रामस्य: Rama's, सीता: Sita, प्रसह्य: by force, यदा: at that time, इह: here, अहृता: brought, तदा: then, सकृत् formerly, समीक्ष्यैव: should have discussed, चित्तम् mind, यमुना: Yamuna, यामुनमिव: like it fills Yamuna mountain, सुनिश्चितम् decided, भजेत: would be.

40014538.author: Translation
40014538.content: "If you had at that time, that is before bringing Sita by force, which was accompanied by Rama and Lakshmana, discussed, and thought of, then you would be sure in your mind like the Yamuna River filling the Yamuna (mountain )."

40014539.author: पदार्थः
40014539.content: महाराज: great king, अस्य: about, कर्मण: the action, आदावेव: earlier, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, कृतम् done, तव: your, अस्माभिःसह: along with us, विधीयेतयदि: if you had, अप्रतिमम् it would have been very good.

40014539.author: Translation
40014539.content: "Great king If you had discussed with us about all this action earlier, it would have been very good."

40014540.author: पदार्थः
40014540.content: दशानन: Ravana, यः whosoever, नृपः is the king, न्यायेन: justifiably, निश्चितार्थमतिः having sense of determination, राजकार्याणि: princely duties, करोति: does, सः he, पश्चात् later, नसन्तप्यते: will not regret.

40014540.author: Translation
40014540.content: "O Ravana Whoever is the king, having a sense of determination, thinks justifiably and carries out princely duties will not regret."

40014541.author: पदार्थः
40014541.content: अनुपायेन: without proper plan, क्रियमाणानि: tasks carried out, विपरीतानि: contrary to the principle, कर्माणि: tasks, अप्रयते: not auspicious, हवींषीव: like anything fit for oblation, दुष्यन्ति: spoilt.

40014541.author: Translation
40014541.content: "Tasks carried out without proper plan and contrary to the right principles are spoilt like inauspicious oblations offered into sacrificial fire."

40014542.author: पदार्थः
40014542.content: यः whoever, पूर्वकार्याणि: that which has to be performed earlier, कर्माणि: acts, पश्चात् afterwards, अपरकार्याणि: that which has to be done later, पूर्वंच: does earlier, चिकीर्षतिसः seeks to perform, नयानयौ: right and wrong, नवेद: does not know.

40014542.author: Translation
40014542.content: "He who seeks to perform earlier what has to be done later and does later what have to be done earlier is not a knower of right and wrong."

40014543.author: पदार्थः
40014543.content: अधिकम् superior, बलम् strength, प्रसमीक्ष्य: without thinking, कृत्येषु: one who acts, चपलस्य: a hasty one, क्षिप्रम् at once, क्रौञ्चस्य: Krauncha's, खम् digs, द्विजाःइव: like the swans, प्रपद्यन्ते: penetrates and goes.

40014543.author: Translation
40014543.content: A hasty one who acts without thinking of the superior strength (of enemy) gets out at once like the swan penetrates into the crevice of Krauncha (mountain).

40014544.author: पदार्थः
40014544.content: त्वया: by you, अप्रतिचिन्तितम् without thinking, इदम् thus, महत् great, कार्यम् action, आरब्धम् beginning, विषमिश्रम् mixed with poison, अमिषम् इव: like the flesh, रामः Rama, त्वाम् you, दिष्ट्या: fortunately, नावधीत् not killed.

40014544.author: Translation
40014544.content: "Without prior thought this great act has been done by you. Rama has not killed you, fortunately like poison mixed flesh would kill."

40014545.author: पदार्थः
40014545.content: आनघ: sinless one, तस्मात् therefore, त्वया: by you, परैः other than me, समारब्दम् undertaking, अप्रतिमम् which is not possible, कर्म: act अहम् I, तव: your, शत्रून् enemy, हत्वा: killing, समीकरिष्यामि: accomplish your goal.

40014545.author: Translation
40014545.content: "O Sinless Ravana Therefore, that which you have done is not possible for none other than me. I will kill your enemy and accomplish your goal for you."

40014546.author: पदार्थः
40014546.content: निशाचर: Rakshasa, अहम् I, तव: your, शत्रून् enemy, उत्सादयिष्यामि: will ruin them, शक्रविवस्वन्तौ: even Indra and Sun,, पावकमारुतौ: fire and wind god, कुबेरवरुणावपि: even if Kubera and Varuna, तौ: both, अहम् I, योधयिष्यामि: will fight in war.

40014546.author: Translation
40014546.content: "O Rakshasa I will ruin the enemy. I will fight with both of them (Rama and Lakshmana) even if they are Indra and sun, fire god and wind god or Kubera and Varuna."

40014547.author: पदार्थः
40014547.content: गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य: one with mountain like body, महापरिघयोधिनः holding huge iron bar, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्य: with sharp teeth, नर्दतः roaring like a lion, पुरन्दरः Indra, बिभीयात् वै: will run out of fear.

40014547.author: Translation
40014547.content: "If I go with a mountain like body and sharp teeth, holding a huge iron bar roaring like a lion, even Indra will run away out of fear."

40014548.author: पदार्थः
40014548.content: सः he, द्वितीयेन: second, शरेण: arrow, माम् on me, पुनः again, निहनिष्यति: by the time he releases ततः immediately, तस्य: his, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यामि: will drink, कामम् stay quiet, आश्वस: confidently.

40014548.author: Translation
40014548.content: "By the time he releases a second arrow again, I will immediately drink his blood. Stay quiet with confidence."

40014549.author: पदार्थः
40014549.content: दाशरथेः Dasaratha's son, वधेन: by killing, तव: your, सुखावहम् I will make you happy, जयम् victorious, आहर्तुम् will do, अहम् I, यतिष्ये: attempt, लक्ष्मणेनसह: with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama also, हत्वा: on killing, सर्वान् all, हरियूथमुख्यान् Vanara leaders, खादामि: will consume.

40014549.author: Translation
40014549.content: "By killing Rama, I will try to make you happy and victorious. On killing Rama and Lakshmana like that I will consume the Vanara leaders."

40014550.author: पदार्थः
40014550.content: कामम् freely, रमस्व: sport, अग्य्रवारुणीम् best of wines, पिब: drinking, विज्वरः free from fear, हितानि: that which you like, कार्याणि: action, कुरष्व: you may do, रामे: Rama, मया: by me, यमक्षयं: to the god of death, गमिते: on reaching, सीता: Sita,चिराय: for a long time, वशगा: under your control, भविष्यति: will be.

40014550.author: Translation
40014550.content: "You be free from fear, sporting and drinking the best of wines and doing actions that you like. Rama will be sent to the abode of the god of death. On reaching their Sita will be under your control for long." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्वादशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of twelfth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
